Theorem
[Fatou's Lemma] ↗ def:summable-function 1. appE:thm-3\group Measure Theory

Let $\{ f_k\} _{k=1}^\infty $ and $f$ be nonnegative summable functions. Then \[ \int _{\mathbb R^n}\liminf _{k\to \infty }f_k\, dx \leq \liminf _{k\to \infty }\int _{\mathbb R^n}f_k\, dx. \]
